name: Muhammad Samiullah
title: Senior Frontend Engineer
summary: Senior Frontend Engineer building production web applications since June 2019. Strongest in TypeScript, React, frontend architecture, design systems, and complex data-heavy interfaces. Experience owning a shared component library and delivering enterprise microfrontend applications at Innoscripta. Comfortable using Claude and Codex in development, with prior backend experience supporting a primary focus on frontend engineering.

roles.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
highlights: Owned the company-wide UI component library consumed by every microfrontend application, including design tokens, theming, accessibility, and Storybook documentation, eliminating duplicated component code and accelerating feature delivery across teams.

Built the frontend for a transfer pricing platform covering multi-entity intercompany data models, validation-heavy forms, calculation results, and audit trails, replacing a spreadsheet-based process.
Delivered an asset management application covering registration, assignment, depreciation, and disposal, with role-based permissions and reporting views.
Shipped a Jira-style task management application with boards, drag-and-drop, filtering, and real-time updates.
Built a risk management module with a risk register, scoring matrices, mitigation workflows, and dashboards for tracking and reporting active organizational risks.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
highlights: Built a design system with design tokens that standardized UI across multiple products and raised component reuse to approximately 60%.
Delivered a core module of an enterprise application, cutting a key user workflow's completion time by approximately 50% through a redesigned UI and improved data fetching.
Introduced the team's first automated test suite using Jest and React Testing Library, reducing production defects by approximately 30% and enabling safer refactoring.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
highlights: Led delivery of three client-facing web applications from architecture through launch.
Refactored legacy code and introduced linting, typing, and review standards, reducing recurring bug reports by approximately 30%.
Designed database schemas and Node.js/Express APIs with MongoDB, improving API response times under concurrent load.

roles.title: Software Engineer
highlights: Built LAAM's system from scratch, working directly with leadership to help the business reach PKR 2 million+ in daily sales.
Built internal analytics dashboards that replaced manual reporting and halved sales-analysis turnaround time.
Mentored junior engineers and helped establish frontend conventions as the team scaled.

assistant.name: Personal AI Assistant

Added on-screen drawing to help explain how to use software.
Enabled actions such as controlling Spotify and changing system settings, alongside research assistance.
Connected the assistant to Google Sheets, Calendar, Docs, and Obsidian, with support for connecting additional apps.
